title_en: Ibn Taymiyya's Stance on the Hadith That God Created Adam in His Image (Part 6)
description_en: Ibn Taymiyya's stance on the hadith that God created Adam in his image, Part 6. The program 'Divine Unity' (Tawhid) by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV channel.
summary: Continuing the analysis of Ibn Taymiyya's views on the hadith of creation in the divine image within the 'Divine Unity' series.
